# Helios

> A free, open-source GTK4/libadwaita Linux desktop app for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, Muse Code, Kimi Code and OpenRouter coding agents.

Helios keeps provider-backed conversations, model and permission controls, goals, a browser, a terminal and Git review together. Native CLIs retain their own sign-in and authoritative session context; OpenRouter uses Helios's own agent loop and optional key file. Capabilities, approval behaviour and usage reporting vary by provider. Helios sends no telemetry; the chosen providers receive prompts, context and tool results.

Packaged releases target Ubuntu 26.04. Source builds require Python 3.11+, GTK 4.10+, libadwaita 1.5+, GtkSourceView 5 and PyGObject/cairo, plus WebKitGTK 6.0 for the browser and VTE 3.91 for the terminal. Stable APT may lag behind GitHub releases; consult the installation guide before promising latest features from the default APT commands.

This index describes source release 0.114.4. Check the installation guide for the version available from each update channel.

## Start here

- [Complete hosted user guide](https://norvitech.com/helios/docs/): local search, six provider setup guides, sessions, permissions, workspace tools, settings, backups and troubleshooting.
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): latest package, checksums, provider sign-in, a project folder and a first task.
- [README](README.md): screenshots, current features, installation, data paths, contribution and development.
- [Website](https://norvitech.com/helios/): project overview, installation, providers, feature walkthrough and narrated demos.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/spencernorton/helios/releases/latest): tested Debian package, matching source and SHA256SUMS.txt.

## Reference

- [User guide](docs/user-guide.md): sessions, permissions, goals, usage, Rewind, browser, terminal, changes and shortcuts.
- [Agent setup guide](docs/agent-setup.md): shell-based installation and runtime verification; native sign-ins require the account holder.
- [Google account setup](docs/google-subscription.md): Antigravity CLI account routing, native protocol and limits.
- [Kimi membership setup](docs/kimi-subscription.md): Kimi ACP authentication, live models, supported actions and recovery.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): credentials, data flow, trust boundaries and private vulnerability reporting.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): development environment, required CI lanes and pull request expectations.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): released changes.
- [GTK4 gotchas](docs/gtk4-gotchas.md): PyGObject and GTK implementation notes.
